---
title: "About"
---

Structural Engineers' Association – India (SEA-India) is a professional body established to unite structural engineers across the country under a common platform for technical excellence, ethical practice, professional development, and service to society.

The Association recognises that structural engineers have a critical responsibility in safeguarding human life through safe, economical, durable, and sustainable structural systems. SEA-India therefore works towards enhancing professional competence through continuing education, technical interaction, research, publication, and collaboration with industry, academia, and government agencies.

The Association functions in accordance with its registered Bye-laws and is committed to transparency, accountability, inclusiveness, and good governance.
